2027-07-01.name: Daily #273
hints: A mass only pulls the beam toward itself. These seeds need a turn one way, then a turn back.
The marked sphere holds the first mass, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam.

A heavy mass a shadow-width from the beam, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam, turns it toward the second mass. Then a heavy mass a shadow-width from the new beam, before the first seed, turns it back through every seed.
2027-07-01.teach: One mass bends light one way only; an S-shaped path needs two.

2027-07-02.name: Daily #274
hints: No single bend reaches every seed: the beam must turn one way, then back the other. The heavy mass makes the sharper turn.
The marked sphere holds the first mass, close to the star.

A light mass one and a half shadow-widths from the beam, close to the star, turns it toward the second mass. Then a heavy mass a shadow-width from the new beam, before the first seed, turns it back through every seed.
2027-07-02.teach: The bend grows with the mass: twice the mass, twice the turn at the same distance.

2027-07-03.name: Daily #275
hints: The beam must turn three times, one mass per turn. Bend it onto the seeds in the order it reaches them.
The marked sphere holds the first mass, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam.

A heavy mass one and a half shadow-widths from the beam, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam, turns it onto the first seed. Then a heavy mass a shadow-width from the new beam, just past the first seed, turns it back onto the second seed. Then a heavy mass a shadow-width from the new beam, just past the second seed, turns it back onto the last seed.
2027-07-03.teach: Bends compose: each mass turns the beam once more.
